parameters.content:
## ⚖️ Criminal Records + Risk Summary — Searchbug (api_crm)

Search criminal & arrest records by name and state — single or bulk from a CSV — then classify each offense by severity and build a per-person risk summary. Two outputs: a detailed offense log AND a one-row-per-person risk summary.

### How it works
1. Single: enter First Name, Last Name, and State (Middle Name, City, DOB, SSN optional). Bulk: leave First Name blank and upload a CSV (first_name, last_name, middle_name, city, state, date_of_birth, ssn).
2. Validate Input checks each row has a first name, last name, and state; invalid rows are logged as INVALID_INPUT.
3. Valid rows hit the Criminal Records API. Flatten Results makes one row per offense, and Classify Severity tags each FELONY / MISDEMEANOR / OTHER.
4. Two sheets are written:
   • Criminal Records — one row per offense (with severity)
   • Criminal Summary — one row per person: offense / felony / misdemeanor counts, sex-offender flag, latest conviction, and a HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW risk level.

### How to set up
- [ ] Add your Searchbug CO_CODE + PASS in the HTTP Request (Body Parameters)
- [ ] Connect your OWN Google Sheets account in BOTH Save nodes
- [ ] Point them at your own spreadsheet and create two tabs:
      • "Criminal Records" (36 columns — see Save Detail)
      • "Criminal Summary" (11 columns — see Save Summary)
- [ ] Activate and share the form link

### ⚠️ Legal — FCRA
For informational use ONLY. NOT for employment, tenant, credit, or insurance screening (FCRA).

### Risk logic
HIGH = any felony or registered sex offender · MEDIUM = has offenses · LOW = none.

## 1. Single or Bulk Input

Single or Bulk? checks whether the First Name field was filled. Single → straight to Normalize Input; CSV upload → Extract CSV first. Normalize Input standardizes the field names (handles first_name / First Name / FIRST_NAME) so both paths share one schema.

## 2. Map & Validate

Set Search Input maps the inputs to the Searchbug parameters. Validate Input then routes rows that have a first name, last name, and state to the API — invalid rows are logged as INVALID_INPUT.

## 3. Search & Classify

Valid rows go to the Criminal Records API (api_crm); invalid rows go to Set Invalid Row. Flatten Results turns each person's offenses into individual rows, then Classify Severity tags each offense FELONY / MISDEMEANOR / OTHER.

## ⚠️ 4. Save Detail + Risk Summary

Save Detail appends one row per offense (36 columns, incl. severity) to the "Criminal Records" tab. Per-Person Risk Summary aggregates the offenses into one row per person — counts, sex-offender flag, latest conviction, and a HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW risk_level — saved to the "Criminal Summary" tab.

Connect your OWN Google Sheets credential in both Save nodes. Don't click ⋮ → Refresh — it erases the column mapping.

FCRA: informational use only — not for screening.
